notes.title: Update
notes.content: - Technical fixes related to missing items.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- automatic backup system is introduced.
- the problem of incorrect interaction between tools and the “projecting device”  is solved.

notes.title: From Developer
notes.content:
Dear friends, players of the Blacksmith!

Hello everyone, this is Pavel - the developer of the game. The last year has been a bit tough for me - fighting bugs, making new tools and other game improvements have become my main full-time job, firmly planting my hard iron arse in the chair in front of the computer monitor. I'm grateful to the community for liking the project, blacksmiths. And I'll be pulling it for a long, long time, I guess. Perhaps I'll even bring it to a second part. Or an add-on with an advanced random ordering system. We'll see what I can do...
 
Meanwhile, Steam announced the games nominations for various awards. So I thought, why not give it a go? Hell yeah! Six long years of solo development. That's it! I'm asking for your vote in the Most Innovative Gameplay category! Your vote will back me up and support the project. 
Take care.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Fixed minor errors in the code

notes.title: Update
notes.content: - fixed scrolling of the materials menu while working in the forge. Now you can scroll the menu by grabbing directly on the material icons.

notes.title: New Tools!
notes.content:
- Two thin file tools. Look for the them at the Windmill near the Village!
- A special secret device! Curious what it's for...? I think you can find it in the City, in the Old Trade Shop.

notes.title: Files!
notes.content: A new file tool has been added! You can find it at the Windmill location. Those who have already completed all orders at the Windmill will get it for free. You will find it in your inventory.

notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
- The vise and complex anvil have been redesigned. Thanks to new mathematical approaches, there are no more annoying invisible collider walls. Parts can be bent both above and below the vise.
- Fixed a bug with items disappearing in the house/forge scene. (PS. yes, yes it sometimes still appeared if you use junk mice when dragging items).
- Adjusted the wheel on the mouse for scrolling menus.


[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44733633/5eadf33818b43576f4e2b925b9615d19bf71ab22.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
-added a mechanism to return materials that flew off the screen
-added the ability to redo any order if you have completed the main story of the game.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: - fixed possible break of tutorial at start of the game.

notes.title: Discount
notes.content: It's time for fire, hammer and anvil, blacksmith! Money is dust compared to the joy of creation. Still, it's not bad when a little gold can be saved on discounts! The discount will last a week from 15 - 22 April.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: - fixed rare bug with vanishing/freezing of items while managing house/forge.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: -fixed a problem with the "Tutorial". It might not work properly in the starting stages of the game due to the introduction of a new drawing tool.

notes.title: Drawing Tool
notes.content:
Dear players! I've made a whole series of improvements to the game in the past since the release date. Today, due to your numerous requests, I am publishing a new tool in the game. A drawing tool! With its help you will be able to do literally everything, from simple marks on the material to full-fledged paintings! Enjoy your creativity, blacksmiths!
(Full version feature only)

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- fixed the problem of overlapping buttons in the window with completed order and material colliders in forge.
-  rare bug with ropes, straps and chains has been fixed. The game could freeze if you managed to grab the rope when it leaves the screen.

notes.title: Updated
notes.content: - fixed a rare bug related to recognising chain mail on a canvas with an order scheme.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- removed a rare bug with saws and knives freezing.
- removed rare bug with complex anvil leading to anomalies in part topology.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: - adjusted the conditions for obtaining the achievements "Apprentice", "Craftsman" and "Master". For example, previously, by completing the "Long Sword" order with 100% accuracy on the "Master" difficulty level rather than the "Apprentice" difficulty level, you would not get the achievement. This has been corrected.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- fixed a problem related to the canvas with the order sketch and tongs: previously, when moving the canvas, you could accidentally move the tongs (or vice versa).
- the list of recommended materials for the order "Bone Crossbow" has been corrected

notes.title: Update
notes.content: - fixed an issue with fee cost disappearing during order selection.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- introduced a menu that warns the player if he/she is going to take an order without collecting all the recommended items.
- eliminated a rare bug with "freezing" of the saw.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a rare bug with disconnecting chains.
- Added experience threshold notification for forge/home upgrades to prevent players from getting locked out in early game.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: - The behaviour of the saw has been improved. When changing tools, the saw does not knock down parts on the table when entering/exiting. Technical exception - if the place where the saw is called when changing a tool is cluttered with objects, the saw will sweep them aside.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: -tutorials for tools, ropes, potions and magic books have been added to the "Help Menu".

notes.title: Update
notes.content: -fixed a rare bug with incorrect register/unregister of objects on canvas with a sketch while performing an order.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
-resolved the problem with infrequent floating game crash while working in the forge. 
-If you can't run the game from the launcher make sure that your antivirus or windows defender is not blocking it and that the main Blacksmith.exe file is running with administrator rights.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: -fixed the error of launching orders occurring after completing the game.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: -volume tune for items and characters.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
-introduced fps control system. V-Sync, Framerate. V-Sync = 1 by default. To change it, enter the start menu and click on the options menu on the bottom right. 
-fixed flaws with areas on the map.
-fixed flaws in the required items for making an orc saber.
-reduced the size of the lever collider on the crimping pliers.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- improved highlighting of items and characters needed to fulfil orders.
- eliminated the problem of freezing at 30% of loading, typical for some pc configurations.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
-autosave. The game is saved right after you complete an order.
-hammer deformations tune. The volume of metal is better preserved.
-deselect materials by clicking on empty space.
-fix conditions for dwarven gauntlet.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
- The problem with missing materials has been resolved. Branches, poles, etc. now appear in the required quantities
- fixed volume of character voices.
- small typos in the text have been removed
- The operation of the trash can has been optimized. Now it will be very difficult to accidentally throw something away by mistake

notes.title: Japanese localization
notes.content:
Dear players!
The lore of the game has many dozens of pages of dense narrative text. The successful development of the project strongly depends on which languages it will be translated into in the first months from the release date. Therefore, translation into other world languages is a priority. Now the list of languages into which the game will be translated is headed by Japanese. By adding the game to your wish list, telling your friends about it and buying it after release, you are helping the developer to make it happen!
